title: run.yipyap.reply.alert.remediation_started.v1
description: Signal that automated remediation is in progress. Suppresses re-notify for a bounded window until a remediation_result reply arrives.

remediation_id.description: Unique ID minted by the remediator. Correlates this event with the eventual remediation_result reply.

description.description: Human-readable description of the remediation attempt (e.g. "restart pod alpha-5, draining first").

expected_duration_seconds.description: How long the remediator expects this to take. Capped at the channel's max_remediation_seconds (default 600). Renotify-suppression lifts at this timeout even without a remediation_result.
